import re

VERSION = re.compile(r"^bun test (?P<version>v\S+(?: \(\S+\))?)$")
FILE = re.compile(r"^(?P<file>\S+):$")
RESULT = re.compile(r"^\((?P<status>pass|fail|skip|todo)\) (?P<test>\S.*?)(?: \[(?P<duration>[\d.]+m?s)\])?$")
ERROR = re.compile(r"^error: (?P<message>\S.*)$")
EXPECT = re.compile(r"^(?P<key>Expected|Received): (?P<value>.*)$")
FRAME = re.compile(r"^\s+at (?P<frame>\S.*)$")
RUN = re.compile(r"^Ran (?P<tests>\d+) tests? across (?P<files>\d+) files?\. \[(?P<duration>[\d.]+m?s)\]$")
COUNT = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<value>\d+) (?P<key>pass|fail|skip|todo|expect\(\) calls)$")
SOURCE = re.compile(r"^\s*\d+ \|(?: |$)|^\s*\^$")
KEYS = ["file", "status", "test", "duration", "error", "Expected", "Received", "at"]


def parse(lines):
    results, summary, r_lines, s_lines, skip = [], {}, [], [], []
    file, pending = "", {}
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        if SOURCE.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        m = VERSION.match(ln)
        if m:
            summary["version"] = m.group("version")
            s_lines.append(j)
            continue
        m = FILE.match(ln)
        if m:
            file = m.group("file")
            r_lines.append(j)
            continue
        m = ERROR.match(ln)
        if m:
            pending = {"error": m.group("message")}
            r_lines.append(j)
            continue
        m = EXPECT.match(ln)
        if m:
            pending[m.group("key")] = m.group("value")
            r_lines.append(j)
            continue
        m = FRAME.match(ln)
        if m:
            pending["at"] = (pending.get("at", "") + "; " + m.group("frame")).strip("; ")
            r_lines.append(j)
            continue
        m = RESULT.match(ln)
        if m:
            rec = {"file": file}
            rec.update(m.groupdict())
            rec.update(pending)
            results.append({k: rec.get(k) or "" for k in KEYS})
            pending = {}
            r_lines.append(j)
            continue
        m = COUNT.match(ln)
        if m:
            summary[m.group("key")] = m.group("value")
            s_lines.append(j)
            continue
        m = RUN.match(ln)
        if m:
            summary.update(m.groupdict())
            s_lines.append(j)
    return {"blocks": [{"name": "results", "kind": "table", "lines": r_lines, "records": results},
                       {"name": "summary", "kind": "kv", "lines": s_lines, "records": [summary]}],
            "skip": skip}
